One small story

Three small jobs, one phone call.

  3. And the door sticks. Three little jobs, and each one needs a different trade.
  4. So you make one call. Ring 01872 271953. We give free quotations for all new enquiries.

FAQ

Questions people ask us

Short answers to the common ones. For anything else, call us.

Still have a question?01872 271953
What services do you offer?

We offer nine services: Painting & Decorating, Carpentry, Electrical, Roofing, Heating, Guttering, General Building, Renewables and Plumbing.

Do you work on homes and businesses?

Yes. We offer domestic and commercial maintenance services, from an odd job to a home improvement project or an office renovation.

Is the quotation free?

Yes. We give free quotations for all new enquiries.

How do I get in touch?

Call us on 01872 271953 or use the form on this page. We are open 8am to 5pm on weekdays.

Do I need a different firm for each trade?

No. One call covers every trade. Simon Annear Maintenance Ltd is part of a group that brings plumbing, heating, electrical and maintenance trades under one roof.

Where in Cornwall do you work?

We work across Cornwall, including Truro, Redruth, Camborne, Falmouth, Penryn, St Austell, Newquay, Perranporth, St Agnes, Penzance, Helston and Bodmin. If you are not sure we cover you, give us a call.

Who is Simon Annear Maintenance Ltd?

We are part of the Simon Annear group, with Simon Annear Plumbing & Heating Ltd and Simon Annear Electrical Ltd. All trades are under one roof.

Where are you based?

3 Space2Work, Redruth, The Park, Cornwall Business Park West, TR16 5FG.
